{{Quote|However, one the day after the battle, a Corporate Sector Authority Fleet with one ''Victory I'', one Escort Carrier, one Heavy Cruiser, two Sloops, two Gunboats, and a Transport entered the system.|[[Alinda Solaris]]|<ref name="Twin Stars of Kira">{{WEGCite|story=Den of Spies|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>}}
A '''sloop''' was a type of warship. Sloops were among the ships used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector]] [[Picket Fleet/Legends|Picket Fleet]]. Ships with this designation were apparently less significant than [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] and [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] designs, but larger than some smaller [[Warship/Legends|warships]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the real world, a [[Wikipedia:sloop-of-war|sloop-of-war]] was a small warship, normally of British origin. The term had a long history, remaining in official use between 1699 and 1948, and its meaning remained relatively constant, describing ships smaller than normal [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], used for trade protection, coastal work and colonial patrol.

The term is very rarely found in ''Star Wars'' fiction, but it is used to identify some ships of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Picket Fleet/Legends|Picket Fleet]].
